MonitorSearchRequest.description: POST search is read-only unless relatorio is supplied (creates/queues an export). Flat filters win over promoted nested filters. General nested filters are promoted first, then model filters fill absent keys. ordenar_por/ordem are top-level controls and are never promoted. Public docs require modelo; the API also supports cross-model searches without model-specific filters, so this contract keeps modelo optional and requires it for model filters/report. Numeric bounds apply equally to numeric strings.

numero_rps.description: JSON number or numeric string. Numeric bounds apply to the interpreted value; preserve decimal strings without conversion.

x-conditional-rules: Model-specific flat fields require modelo; irrelevant flat fields may be excluded by server validation. Nested filtros_modelo rejects keys not allowed for that model.
For NFSe the server maps serie/numero to serie_rps/numero_rps when explicit RPS fields are absent. Use explicit RPS names to avoid conflicting pairs.
For received NF-e manifestacao filters apply; other models may ignore them.
documentos selects between 1 and 1000 document UUIDs for exports; an empty array is invalid, never equivalent to all documents.
Cursor is opaque and must not be decoded/edited. paginacao=cursor selects cursor mode; cursor presence selects it unless offset is explicitly requested.
Sending relatorio creates asynchronous report state and is not a read-only test. Do not retry report generation silently.

log.description: Unmodified provider event log; known documented keys are modeled, additional provider data remains allowed.

MonitorEvent.description: Known events include cancellation, correction, manifestation, CT-e/MDF-e links, delivery and closure. Null fields are omitted; unknown/provider-specific event data must be preserved.

MonitorManifestationRequest.description: Only evento=1 is currently accepted. manifestacao:1 confirmation, 2 unknown, 3 operation not performed, 4 awareness. Justification is required for 3; verify event eligibility for the document/role before sending.

xml.description: Strict base64 XML; decoded limit is server-configured (default 1 MiB), independent of encoded length.

MonitorImportRequest.description: Exactly one of chave,xml,url_arquivo_zip. Company must belong to this account, be active, have a valid certificate and participate in/hold authorization for the document. ZIP URL must satisfy server fetch policy. Import changes persistent document/processing state; never part of read-only probes.

MonitorImportStatus.description: ZIP import state; total/empresa_uuid/error may be absent. Documented statuses processando,concluido,invalido are not assumed exhaustive.

cnpj.description: Valid CNPJ, including the supported alphanumeric format; server normalizes punctuation. The identifier must be unique within the provider constraints.

cpf.description: Valid CPF; server normalizes punctuation. Do not convert document identifiers to numbers.

certificado_base64.description: Base64 PFX A1 certificate; validated with its password and the company identifier. Keep out of logs and errors.

MonitorCreateCompanyRequest.description: Create a monitored company; this changes persistent configuration and may schedule download processing.
x-conditional-rules: At least one of CPF/CNPJ is required on create; certificate, certificate password, legal name and postal code are required. Updates validate only supplied fields.

modelos_download cte provisions the CT-e family, including model 67 / CT-e OS. Search/response subtype remains cte_os. The API also accepts nfce, but this contract does not expose that token because it is not advertised in the five-model public Monitor matrix; its acceptance is not a supported-capability promise.
Empty modelos_download on update removes monitoring selections. On create, omission defaults to nfe; a supplied array must have at least one item.
categorias_download applies to NFS-e: 1 received, 2 issued, 3 both. Other model participation and municipal/provider availability govern actual downloads.
dfe_retroativas=true is irreversible for that company: setting it back to false is rejected. It can restore historical hidden documents and affect processing/billing; do not use in read-only tests.
status 1 active / status 2 inactive. Certificate/URL updates are service-validated and may affect scheduled collection.
